messages.content: 你能幫我比較兩個不同可再生能源項目的潛在能量輸出嗎？第一個項目是位於37.7749和-122.4194座標的太陽能場，總太陽能板面積為50000平方英呎。我想知道七月的預估能量輸出。第二個項目是位於40.7128和-74.0060座標的風力發電場，共有100座風力發電機。我也想知道這個風力發電場七月的預估能量輸出。

function.name: windFarm_potential
function.description: Estimate the energy output of a wind farm given its location and turbine count for a particular month. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of the location of the wind farm.

turbineCount.description: The total number of wind turbines at the location. This is a float type value.

month.description: The month for which to calculate the potential energy output.

function.name: solarFarm_potential
function.description: Estimate the energy output of a solar farm given its location and panel area for a particular month. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of the location of the solar farm.

panelArea.description: The total solar panel area in square feet at the location. This is a float type value.

month.description: The month for which to calculate the potential energy output.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to compare two renewable energy projects: a solar farm at coordinates (37.7749, -122.4194) with panel area 50,000 sq ft, month July; and a wind farm at coordinates (40.7128, -74.0060) with 100 turbines, month July. We need to call the functions: solarFarm_potential and windFarm_potential. Provide arguments accordingly.

We should call solarFarm_potential first? The order doesn't matter but we can do solar first then wind. Provide coordinates as array [lat, lon] or [lon, lat]? The function expects coordinates: number[]. Usually coordinates are [latitude, longitude]. We'll use [37.7749, -122.4194] and [40.7128, -74.0060].

Also provide month "July" or "07"? The function expects month?: string. Likely month name or numeric string. Use "July".

Return values from functions will be printed. We'll call them sequentially.
